title: Why Nobody Can Stop North Korea
summary: Explains why military strikes, sanctions, assassination and diplomacy all fail to stop North Korea's nuclear programme, and how demographics may erode South Korea's edge.

assertions.quote: which of course includes the entirety of the U.S Mainland

verdicts.note: EFIS notes North Korea's new Hwasong-20 ICBM, unveiled in 2025, has a reported range of 15,000 km, enough for the continental US (reported, not tested).
US intelligence states North Korea has successfully tested ICBMs capable of reaching the entire US homeland.

assertions.quote: the ultimate point of North Korea acquiring tactical nuclear weapons though isn't to necessarily use them but to Simply continue deterring the United States
the north knows that it is 100 guaranteed to lose a conventional conflict

verdicts.note: US and South Korean forces far outmatch the North's ageing conventional forces, though the North could inflict heavy damage first.

assertions.quote: North Korea's artillery could deliver tens of thousands of shells directly into Seoul within a few minutes notice
China continues to trade extensively with North Korea and enables them to bypass many of their International sanctions

verdicts.note: China accounts for the vast majority of North Korea's trade and has enforced UN sanctions loosely.

assertions.quote: to the Chinese North Korea effectively functions as a kind of buffer State between themselves and the U.S military

verdicts.note: Chinese strategists widely describe North Korea as a buffer, and Beijing keeps the 1961 alliance treaty in force.

assertions.quote: surrendering their nuclear weapons exposes their vulnerability to hostile outside powers

verdicts.note: Libya and Ukraine were attacked after disarming, but Iraq had no weapons to give up, and South Africa and Kazakhstan were never attacked.

assertions.quote: convincing them otherwise through diplomacy economic sanctions or military intervention is almost certain to be a Fool's errand
within just 20 to 30 years from now the numbers of military age men in both countries will have effectively equalized

verdicts.note: South Korea's manpower pool is shrinking fast, but its economic and technological lead over the North remains vast.

assertions.quote: 71 percent of South Koreans were in favor of their country acquiring their own nuclear weapons
